parameters.content:
PURPOSE
Perform targeted research only when an important evidence gap exists.

OWNER
PAOLA TRACK A

INPUT CONTRACT
missing_evidence_request with retry_count, max_retries, reason_for_retry

OUTPUT CONTRACT
new evidence or UNKNOWN marker

STATUS
Skeleton only. Inactive by default. No credentials. Configure TODO nodes after import.

RETRY CONTROL
Required fields: retry_count, max_retries, reason_for_retry.
No infinite loops. Parent workflow must stop retrying when retry_count >= max_retries.
